outfit.name: 冷灰小香风粗花呢套装与露肌过膝袜
outfit.prose: A cropped silver-grey bouclé tweed jacket with faux-pearl buttons and piped pockets, layered over a black silk camisole and a matching A-line tweed mini skirt. Worn with opaque black over-knee stockings that gently indent the bare upper thigh, anchored by double-buckle leather garters and black leather penny loafers.
